Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Cohort is excited about Redwood's latency profile for our office hours demos. We have a practical billing/packaging question as we stand up a 12-week accelerator cohort starting Sept 1.

High level ask: can Redwood make the "StarterPack" onboarding credits split across two billing entities for this pilot? Cohort will run the program and should retain an administrative allotment, but each accepted startup (about 8 of them) will get a smaller credit pool that we'd like to invoice separately for bookkeeping reasons.

What we'd like to understand from your side:
- Is it possible to allocate a single promotional credit pool across multiple invoices (Cohort as parent + 8 child invoices)?
- If not, can we create separate promo codes/credits for each startup that draw from a single negotiated spend/discount?
- Any constraints on rollover (we'd prefer 60 days) or transfer between child accounts if a startup drops out.
- Preferred invoicing flow and whether Redwood takes a single master invoice from Cohort or issues per-startup invoices.

Attached is our pilot brief (accelerator-onepager.pdf) for context. Expected usage per startup is 150k tokens/month on average in the first 60 days, scaled down in demo phase.

We'd like to have a short call (30 mins) next week to finalize packaging and get a SOW so we can start contracting. Are you available Wed or Thu morning PT?

Best,
Emily

Quick answers to unblock the call scheduling:
- We can support per-startup promo allocations, but there are two ways to implement (per-account promo codes vs. internal allocation tied to a master deal). Each has different controls for rollover and refund.
- Rollover for promotional credits isn't our default for some promo types, but we have allowed limited windows (30–90 days) for accelerators with documented pilots.
- On invoicing: we typically support either a single master invoice to the program or segregated invoices per billing entity — the latter requires tax/billing entity setup for each child account.

Ben: can you draft two concrete options (one that minimizes ops for Cohort and one that gives the startups independent invoices) + the rough pricing math based on Emily's usage estimate? Laura: can you flag any finance approval or tax documentation we’ll need if Redwood issues child invoices?

Hi all — following up with two implementable options and a recommended commercial for a 12-week pilot. See the attached pricing workbook for line-by-line math.

Option A (low ops, program-managed):
- Redwood issues a single master promo pool of $12,000 in equivalent credits to Cohort (reflects 8 startups x $1,500 each + admin buffer).
- Cohort manages internal distribution to startups; Redwood invoices Cohort only (one invoice).
- Rollover: up to 60 days for unused credits, non-transferable between cohorts unless agreed in writing.
- Advantage: simplest for Redwood ops and for Cohort accounting.

Option B (per-startup autonomy, higher ops):
- Redwood creates 9 child billing entities (Cohort + 8 startups) and issues per-account promo allocations totaling $12,000.
- Redwood invoices each entity for any overage beyond allocated credits.
- Rollover: 30 days by default; 60 days can be negotiated with a small admin fee (we propose $150 flat to offset tracking).
- Advantage: startups have clean invoices for their books; more admin on both sides.

Commercial suggestion for pilot (recommended):
- Commit: Cohort signs a 12-week pilot SOW with a $5,000 refundable deposit (applied to credits) and an admin fee of $250 for per-child entity setup if Option B chosen.
- Overages: billed monthly at list rates with standard volume discounts after $50k/mo aggregate.

Attachments included: Cohort_Onboarding_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW draft), pricing-workbook.xlsx (detailed math). I've also created the HubSpot opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/DEAL-3492

Next steps:
- Emily: confirm preferred option and whether Cohort will take master invoicing or wants per-startup invoices.
- If Option B, Laura: please advise on the tax docs we should collect upfront (W-9 equivalents, VAT IDs).
- If accepted, I’ll send the SOW via DocuSign for signature.
